items.item: STS3215 servos, 12 V 30 kg version (C018 / Waveshare ST3215 30 kg)
items.note: Follower arm only (no leader). Rule: buy on Amazon UK if servos + board come under about £135; otherwise ArmDojo (Singapore, about S$30 each, free shipping over S$110, ~20% UK VAT on delivery): https://armdojo.com/products/feetech-sts3215-serial-bus-servo. Not stocked by RobotShop UK (twice the price, out of stock), The Pi Hut, Pimoroni, RS or Farnell. Each servo comes with a 15 cm cable.

items.item: Servo driver board (Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter A)
items.note: One board drives all six servos, daisy-chained. No Arduino needed: the laptop runs the software over USB. Also on Amazon UK and ArmDojo (https://armdojo.com/products/waveshare-bus-servo-adapter-board); buy from the same shop as the servos.
Optional, for longer joint runs. Ready-made connectors.
Match the driver board's USB-C port.

items.item: 12 V power supply, at least 5 A (100–240 V input)
items.note: Check home first: label must say 12 V and 5 A or more, 5.5 × 2.1 mm barrel plug, centre-positive. Otherwise buy on Amazon. 100–240 V input so it works in Brazil.
Follower arm needs about 400 g. Weigh the current spool first (subtract about 230 g for an empty plastic spool). Print one test part before the rest.
GTMax3D is an authorised Bambu Lab reseller in Brazil. Other shops: bambulab.com/pt-br/where-to-buy. Pending a chat with Mum.
Bulky and generic, so buy locally.
